scheme_name: Financial Grants In Aid To SC/ST Patients Suffering From Cancer And Other Malignant Diseases
other_conditions: Applicant must belong to a SC/ST community of Assam
Applicant must be suffering from cancer or other malignant diseases
An individual can claim the financial aid only once
benefits_summary: One-time financial assistance of ₹ 50,000 is provided to eligible SC/ST cancer patients in Assam.
